screenReviewObservations: All original pictures and independent PDF render contacts inspected. Character activities, costumes, object framing and logos are distinct. Map artwork is decorative, not a verified game world layout. Visible wording Download denotes lettering inside the artwork, never a game installer.

similarityReview.algorithm: foreground-cropped 64-bit DCT pHash, Hamming distance <=10, nearest four; actual contact sheets also reviewed for concept repetition
similarityReview.reviewObservations: All 63 candidates inspected side by side. DCT matches with old animals, fruit and objects are unrelated silhouettes. Incoming Lucia standing poses have distinct backpack/radio/map/folder/umbrella compositions. No near-identical redraw or recolor accepted as a new design. All 300 originals also reviewed by subject together.

duplicateReview.algorithm: SHA-256 of file bytes and decoded RGBA with invisible RGB zeroed

discoveryReview.note: Mature-game character, weapon and logo compositions are not cute-discovery selections.
